verses.1: And all of Israel became scattered. Their names were recorded in the register of the kings of Israel and Judah. They were exiled to Babylon, forever.
verses.2: And the first ones who sat in their positions in the cities of Israel were the priests, the Levites, and the elders.
verses.3: And in Jerusalem, those who were descendants of the Israelites, along with those who were descendants of Benjamin, and those who were descendants of Ephraim, would live there.
verses.4: Uthai ben-Amihud, ben-Ameri, ben-Imri, ben-Bani, from the sons of Peraz, ben-Yehuda.
verses.5: And from the shiloni, he created the bokhor and its children.
verses.6: And from the sons of Zerah, Yeoel and Ahiah, there were sixteen and seventy.
verses.7: And from the sons of Benyamin, Salu, son of Mashlam, son of Hodvaia, son of Sana’.
verses.8: And Yevaniah son of Yeroham, and Ela son of Uziy, son of Mikri, and Mesulam son of Shaftiyah, son of Reu’el, son of Yevaniah.
verses.9: And they were given to their wives: five thousand, and fifty-six more. All these people were the heads of their fathers’ houses.
verses.10: And from the priests, one will be chosen to act as a leader and organizer.
verses.11: And Azariah son of Hilkia, son of Meshalal, son of Zadok, son of Meroida, son of Ahitub will judge in the house of God.
verses.12: And Adiah, son of Jeroham; and Pashhur, son of Meshaiah; and Malchiah, son of Ediael; and Jahzirah, son of Meshalom; and Meshilimith, son of Immer.
verses.13: And they brought back to their homes thousands and seven thousand of the most noble warriors from the army, who were employed in serving the temple.
verses.14: And from the sons of Eliphaz, sons of Esau, sons of Jokshan.
verses.15: And in the morning, there were cries and wails; Mata’nyah, son of Michah, son of Zikri, son of Asaf.
verses.16: And he served Bane-Shmeya, Bane-Gallal, Bane-Yedutun, and Berekhya, Bane-Asa, Bane-Elkanah, who ruled in the palaces of Netofati.
verses.17: And the shepherds were Shalom, Akub, Talmon, Ahiman, and Ahiyhem. Shalom was the leader among them.
verses.18: And as far as the gate of the king’s palace, from the east, there were many gates leading to the camps of the children of Levi.
verses.19: And Shalom ben-Kor’ah, son of Avishaf ben-Korach, and his brothers went to the house of their father, the Korachs. They were responsible for taking care of the tools used for construction. Their fathers, on the other hand, were in charge of the storehouses belonging to Jehovah.
verses.20: And Pinchas son of Elazar was the one who spoke to them before Jehovah.
verses.21: Zekariah, son of Meseliah, was the one who opened the door to the temple.
verses.22: They all became rulers in the houses of the kings. In their palaces, there were twenty-one kings. They established David and Solomon as their leaders. They truly believed in their promises.
verses.23: And they and their children stood on the doors of the House of God, in order to guard it.
verses.24: In four directions, the doors will be located from the eastern side of the sky, towards the north and south.
verses.25: And they lived in their houses, coming together on the seven days from day to day with those people.
verses.26: For in truth, there are four kinds of people who live in the chambers: they are the Levites. They lived on the looms and in the workshops within the Temple of God.
verses.27: And around the house of God, there were songs being sung; they sang on the thresholds and at dawn every morning.
verses.28: And from them, all kinds of labor will be brought forth in their appointed time, and also taken away in their appointed time.
verses.29: And they are used for preparing all kinds of dishes, as well as for preparing all kinds of sacred foods. They’re also used for making sauces, vinegars, and other condiments.
verses.30: And from the sons of the priests, those who prepare the offerings for the sacrifices, they shall offer them as offerings to God.
verses.31: And Maitiyah from the Levites is the one who will be punished for the evil deeds of those who commit sins.
verses.32: And from the sons of Khati, from among their brothers, let there be chosen those who will prepare the bread for the Sabbath.
verses.33: And these workers are the heads of the Levites, who work in the fields from day to night.
verses.34: These are the heads of the fathers of the Levites, who will give birth to their children. These people will sit in Jerusalem.
verses.35: And in Gibeon, Abi-Gibeon Yeyiel and his wife Ma’achah lived there.
verses.36: And his offspring include servants, slaves, and those who are submissive. There are also men, women, and children among them.
verses.37: And Gdor, and his brothers, and Zekharia, and Mikloot.
verses.38: And from their descendants will come those who will live in Jerusalem with their brothers.
verses.39: And Nehor had children named Kish. Kish, in turn, had children named Shaul. Shaul, in turn, had children named Yehonatan. Yehonatan, in turn, had children named Malchiah Shu’a and Abinadab. And Ashbel also had children.
verses.40: And Benjamin, son of Yehonatan, became jealous of his father. He caused strife between his father and him. From this strife, Michah was born.
verses.41: And the sons of Michah were Pithon and Melchizedek.
verses.42: And the forest will hold onto its trees; and the trees will hold onto the world, as well as their songs. And those songs will continue to be sung forever.
verses.43: And from him came Benya and Rfaya. From them came Elashah, and from them came Atsel.
verses.44: And there were six sons, and their names were Azrikam, Bokhru, Yishmael, Shae’ryah, Ovedya, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
